Daniel Okonkwo-Rasmussen
Senior QA Engineer

Summary
Senior QA engineer who believes a release without tests is a rumour. I build test suites that developers actually run, wire them into CI/CD and keep an eye on production with proper dashboards.

Experience
Senior QA Engineer · Brindlewick Software (Jan 2016 – Present)
- Built the end-to-end suite with Playwright and Cypress: 900 tests running on every pull request.
- Rewrote the old Selenium scripts in Playwright and cut flaky failures by 80%.
- Unit and component tests with Jest alongside the web team.
- Owned the CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, with test reports and automatic retries.
- Set up Sentry and Grafana dashboards so we hear about bugs before anyone else does.
- Ran monthly bug bashes focused on testability and clear bug reports.

Skills
Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Jest, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Sentry, Grafana, Docker, Git

Education

Projects
